_comment: Mutation testing. The suite is a lib0/testing harness driven by a plain node entrypoint, so Stryker uses the command runner (exit code = pass/fail). That runner has no per-test coverage analysis, so every mutant pays a full ~10s suite run and a whole run takes ~40 minutes — use --mutate when iterating. Score went 53.07 -> 63.68 as the lifecycle and teardown paths gained real assertions; there are no uncovered mutants, so the remaining survivors are all reachable and break=60 should be raised as they are killed.
